encoding: uint16 little-endian, rows north to south, columns west to east
citation: Christensen, P. R., et al., 2001, Mars Global Surveyor Thermal Emission Spectrometer experiment: investigation description and surface science results, J. Geophys. Res. 106, 23823–23871; USGS Mars_MGS_TES_Albedo_mosaic_global_7410m (bolometric albedo), 8 px/deg

source.label: https://asc-pds-services.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/mosaic/Mars_MGS_TES_Albedo_mosaic_global_7410m.lbl
source.note: matches the MD5 the USGS publishes beside the file

resampling: nearest: each 0.5° output cell holds the one 8 px/deg source cell containing its centre; nothing averaged; stored × 10000, rounded to four decimals
noDataRule: a NaN or ISIS special pixel in the source, or a cell centred poleward of 87°
